```{r}
moral<-read.csv( "data/stimuli.csv") %>% 
  select(ID,moral=rot.moral.foundations) %>% 
    mutate(ID = as.factor(ID))

df<-read.csv( "data/df_all_long_updated.csv") %>% 
  mutate(rater=ifelse(label_type=="human","human","llm")) %>% 
  mutate(unique_id=paste0(label_type,"_",human_id)) %>% 
  mutate(ID=as.factor(ID)) %>% 
  mutate(
  across(
    ends_with(c("_reaction", "_reaction_should")),
    ~ case_when(
      .x %in% c("Celebrate / praise", "Praise") ~ "Praise",
      .x %in% c("Do nothing") ~ "Do nothing",
      .x %in% c("Gossip", "Gossip about / discuss with / complain to others informally") ~ "Gossip",
      .x %in% c("Inform authority", "Inform the authorities, such as the police") ~ "Inform authority",
      .x %in% c("Physical confrontation") ~ "Physical confrontation",
      .x %in% c("Stay away", "Stay away or keep a distance from the actor") ~ "Stay away",
      .x %in% c("Support", "Support the actor") ~ "Support",
      .x %in% c("Verbal confrontation", "Verbal reprimand / verbal confrontation") ~ "Verbal confrontation",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )
) %>% 
  left_join(moral, by = "ID") %>% 
    mutate(source = ifelse(label_type %in% c("claude","gemini","gpt_5.2"),"close-source",ifelse(label_type=="human","human","open-source"))) 

```

# emotion 

```{r}
emotion_long <- df %>%
  select(rater,unique_id,label_type,source, ID,moral, target=emotion_type,emotion,strength_value) %>% 
  filter(strength_value>0) %>% 
  mutate(
    target = dplyr::recode(
      target,
      "emotion_actor" = "actor",
      "emotion_friend" = "strong tie",
      "emotion_acquaintance" = "weak tie",
      "emotion_stranger" = "stranger"
    ),
    target = factor(target, levels = c("actor", "strong tie", "weak tie", "stranger"))
  )

```
### test 

```{r}
chi_results_emotion <- emotion_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(moral), !is.na(emotion), !is.na(source), !is.na(target), emotion != "") %>%
  group_by(source, target) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    tab <- table(.x$moral, .x$emotion)

    if (nrow(tab) < 2 || ncol(tab) < 2 || sum(tab) == 0) {
      return(tibble(
        statistic = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        label = "NA (low variation)"
      ))
    }

    test <- tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(test)) {
      return(tibble(
        statistic = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        label = "NA (failed)"
      ))
    }

    tibble(
      statistic = unname(test$statistic),
      df = unname(test$parameter),
      p_value = test$p.value,
      label = ifelse(test$p.value < .001, "***", "ns")
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

print(chi_results_emotion)
```


### plot
```{r, fig.width=10,fig.height=6}

# compute proportions within each panel
emotion_props <- emotion_long %>%
  count(source, moral, target, emotion) %>%
  group_by(source, moral, target) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# plot
p_emotion <- ggplot(
  emotion_props,
  aes(x = moral, y = prop, fill = emotion, color = emotion)
) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(
    source ~ target
    ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("-.*", "", x)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  labs(
    y = "Proportion",
    x = "Moral Foundation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") 

p_emotion
```



# action by moral foundation
### dataset
```{r}
action_vars <- c(
  "strangers_reaction",
  "acquaintances_reaction",
  "friends_reaction",
  "strangers_reaction_should",
  "acquaintances_reaction_should",
  "friends_reaction_should"
)

df_action <- df %>%
  select(rater,unique_id,label_type, ID,moral,source, all_of(action_vars)) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  rename_with(~ .x %>%
    # tie strength
    str_replace("^strangers", "stranger") %>%
    str_replace("^acquaintances", "weak_tie") %>%
    str_replace("^friends", "strong_tie") %>%
    # action type
    str_replace("_reaction_should$", "_should") %>%
    str_replace("_reaction$", "_would"),
    all_of(action_vars)
  )

df_long <- df_action %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = stranger_would:strong_tie_should,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "response"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # optional: clean ordering of responses
    response = factor(response,
      levels = c(
        "Do nothing", "Stay away", "Gossip",
        "Inform authority", "Verbal confrontation",
        "Physical confrontation", "Support", "Praise"
      )
    ),
    # separate actual vs should (useful later)
    type = ifelse(grepl("should", variable), "should", "would")
  )

```
### descriptive
```{r}
stats_counts <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(response)) %>%
  group_by(moral, variable, response, source) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

stats_props <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(response)) %>%
  group_by(moral, variable, response, source) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(moral, variable, source) %>%
  mutate(
    total_n = sum(n),
    prop = ifelse(total_n > 0, n / total_n, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

chi_results <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(moral), !is.na(response), !is.na(source), !is.na(variable)) %>%
  group_by(source, variable) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    tab <- table(.x$moral, .x$response)

    # check structure
    if (nrow(tab) < 2 || ncol(tab) < 2 || sum(tab) == 0) {
      return(tibble(
        statistic = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        label = "NA (low variation)"
      ))
    }

    test <- tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(test)) {
      return(tibble(
        statistic = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        label = "NA (failed)"
      ))
    }

    tibble(
      statistic = unname(test$statistic),
      df = unname(test$parameter),
      p_value = test$p.value,
      label = ifelse(test$p.value < .001, "***", "ns")
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

print(chi_results)

```
### plot
```{r,fig.width=12,fig.height=6}
p<-ggplot(stats_props, aes(x = moral, y = prop, fill = response, color = response)) +
  geom_col(
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    source ~ variable,
    labeller = labeller(
      source = function(x) gsub("_", "\n", x),
      variable = function(x) gsub("_", "\n", x)
    )
    )+
  labs(
    x = "Response",
    y = "Proportion"
  ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("-.*", "", x)) +  # keep text before "-"

  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +  # increases overall text size
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),  # facet labels
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13)
  )+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") 
p
```
